$comment: SCREENS THAT CANNOT RENDER WITHOUT AN INPUT THE HARNESS MUST NOT INVENT.
The render harness gives every screen the context the app gives it — AuthProvider, a real
navigator, an unlocked vault. It deliberately passes EMPTY route params, because filling them
with plausible values would be inventing the screen's inputs, and a screen that renders only
because the harness guessed its parameters has not been shown to render: it has been shown to
A screen listed here is REPORTED, never skipped and never hidden. Every entry must name the
criterion or work package that will clear it, so the register cannot become somewhere to put a
screen nobody wants to fix. `p2:gate -- render-harness` prints every entry on every run.
AN ENTRY IS CLEARED by giving the screen a real fixture — a committed params file a reviewer
can read — not by deleting the line.
THE REGISTER IS CURRENTLY EMPTY. DecisionScreen was its only entry; WP-2.3 removed the two
invented scores and the canned per-verdict reasons from that screen (D6) and supplied the
fixture at __tests__/fixtures/DecisionScreen.params.json, which is exactly what the entry said
would clear it. The empty array is kept rather than the key being dropped: an absent register
and an empty one are different claims, and only one of them says "nothing is waiting".
